all_found.desc: [ADVISORY] The Stale status returns Installed:false for an earlier (e.g. pre-#173 checkout-local) location whose gate scripts are still in place and still block pushes, so enforcementStatus appends 'The git-native pre-push gate is not installed either, so nothing stops a host...'. Every upgraded pre-#173 user reading setup --check before migrating is told pushes are ungated when they are still gated.

[ADVISORY] The released()/repoHooksID doc comments say a dir becomes free because an uninstall took the scripts out and that uninstall+reinstall reuses it that way, but uninstall no longer removes scripts from a user-level dir (reuse comes from the recorded metareview.hooksId). A maintainer may reintroduce emptying on uninstall, the bug fixed in d368145.

[ADVISORY] Installed is now true for a stale earlier location that still gates, but the GitGateStatus.Installed field doc ('byte-current hook scripts') and the gitGateStatus doc (Installed via HooksCurrent) were not updated. JSON consumers trusting the documented contract could read Installed:true as current scripts.
